subject: biology
promptStrong: Give me a 6-mark exam-style question on {lo} for {board} {level} {subject}, then mark my answer against the mark scheme.
promptWeak: Explain {lo} for {board} {level} {subject} simply, with a worked example and the most common mistake students make.

questions.q: What does protease break protein down into?
questions.explain: Protease enzymes digest proteins into amino acids.

questions.q: Why does the stomach produce hydrochloric acid?
options: To provide the optimum pH for stomach protease and kill bacteria
questions.explain: The acidic conditions kill pathogens and give the right pH for the protease in the stomach to work.

questions.q: Rose black spot is caused by which type of pathogen?
questions.explain: Rose black spot is a fungal disease that produces purple/black spots on leaves and reduces plant growth.

questions.q: Antibodies produced by lymphocytes are specific because they:
options: Lock onto a particular antigen on one type of pathogen
Form a physical barrier on the skin
questions.explain: Each antibody has a complementary shape to a specific antigen, so it targets only one pathogen type.

questions.q: HIV is best described as a pathogen that is a:
options: Virus that attacks white blood cells (lymphocytes)
Bacterium that lives in the gut
questions.explain: HIV is a virus that attacks and destroys lymphocytes, eventually leading to AIDS if untreated.
Bile is produced in the liver and then stored in the gall bladder.

questions.q: Which organ produces amylase, protease and lipase?
questions.explain: The pancreas makes all three types of digestive enzyme and releases them into the small intestine.

questions.q: Why does the large intestine play a role at the end of digestion?
options: It absorbs amino acids into the blood
It absorbs water from undigested food to form faeces
questions.explain: The large intestine absorbs water, leaving solid faeces to be egested.

questions.q: Which of these is a NON-specific first line of defence against pathogens?
options: The skin acting as a barrier
questions.explain: The skin is a physical barrier that is non-specific, stopping pathogens entering before the immune response.

questions.q: In a double-blind drug trial, which statement is correct?
options: Neither the patient nor the doctor knows who has the real drug or placebo
Patients choose whether to take the drug or placebo
No placebo is used at all
Only the doctor knows who has the placebo
questions.explain: In a double-blind trial neither patient nor researcher knows who receives the drug, reducing bias.

questions.q: Tobacco mosaic virus (TMV) affects which type of organism?
questions.explain: TMV is a plant pathogen that causes a mosaic pattern of discolouration on leaves, reducing photosynthesis.

questions.q: Which disease is caused by a protist spread by mosquitoes?
questions.explain: Malaria is caused by a protist, with mosquitoes acting as vectors that transfer it between people.
